---
title: "Estimation walkthroughs"
---

Each walkthrough derives one estimator step by step on a small data set: the objective, the matrices, the solution, the uncertainty, and, where it applies, the likelihood. The pages show saved outputs, so reading them needs no Python or R. Agreement with R and the other references is reported on the [Verification](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification) pages, and speed on the [Benchmarks](https://phit.phpstats.org/benchmarks) pages.

| Estimator | Walkthrough | Verification | Benchmark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OLS | [Mathematics](ols-math.qmd) · [Rust implementation](../ols-math.qmd) | [OLS](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/ols) | [OLS](https://phit.phpstats.org/benchmarks/ols) |
| Logistic regression | [Likelihood, IRLS, and Wald inference](logistic-math.qmd) | [Logistic](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/logistic) | [Logistic](https://phit.phpstats.org/benchmarks/logistic) |
| Probit regression | [Likelihood, scoring, and inference](probit-math.qmd) | [Probit](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/probit) | [Probit](https://phit.phpstats.org/benchmarks/probit) |
| Poisson regression | [Likelihood, scoring, and inference](poisson-math.qmd) | [Poisson](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/poisson) | [Poisson](https://phit.phpstats.org/benchmarks/poisson) |
| Gaussian random intercept | [Covariance, marginal likelihood, and shrinkage](lmm-math.qmd) | [Random intercept](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/lmm) · [Published data](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/lmm-public) | [Random intercept](https://phit.phpstats.org/benchmarks/lmm) |
| Random slopes and REML | [Penalized least squares, QR elimination, and ML/REML terms](lmm-general-math.qmd) | [R compatibility](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/r-compatibility) | |
| Binomial random intercept | [Likelihood and integration](logistic-mixed-math.qmd) | [Binomial mixed](https://phit.phpstats.org/verification/logistic-mixed) | [Binomial mixed](https://phit.phpstats.org/benchmarks/logistic-mixed) |

The published data sets used by the mixed-model pages, with their provenance and licenses, are described in [Published data sets](../data/lmm/index.qmd).
